desc: Count positive values up to `x` containing an actual (non-leading) zero digit with a digit DP.
For each target digit sum `S`, use digit DP states `(position, digit_sum, product_mod_S, started, tight)` restricted to nonzero actual digits after starting.
Count terminal zero-free states with `started`, digit sum `S`, and product remainder 0.
Ensure leading zeros neither contribute to digit sum/product nor count as actual zero digits.
Execute sample, brute-force small-range, boundary, and performance tests to validate the implementation.
